'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tim Heffner DS Separatist Uprising''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tim Heffner]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Separatist Uprising / At War With Itself]]
* '''Username:''' Darth Tim
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
